spec.title: IED security documentation survey: catalogue inventory
spec.note: Rules that turn each vendor's own catalogue listing into inventory entries. A rule reads one field: 'url', 'slug' (last path segment) or 'text' (model name and, where the vendor gives one, its one-line product type; during enrich, the product page's title and opening words). The first matching rule wins and an exclusion always beats a category. Change a rule and re-apply it with: survey.py inventory --from <previous inventory>.
